cn_reference.authority: none — cross-market context only; no status value, ordering, candidate, rank, gate, size, Prophet/Neural Web fact, legal-band verdict or trade may be derived automatically from it
cn_reference.legal_limit_boundary: per rewritten #4972, adjusted prices cannot establish exact legal-limit touches/seals, nominal CNY bands, or the quarantined 300363 account. Any such verdict requires authorized unadjusted TuShare daily plus same-key stk_limit with exact integer-cent equality. None is claimed here
cn_reference.note: the historical CN adjusted-return ordering that the draft v1 constants encoded, restated so the US numbers are read against the context that prompted the test. CN Prophet standout-board admissions, CSI300-relative, H=10, n=257 — not a US measurement and not an exchange-limit study
cn_reference.price_basis_caveat: the legacy instrument reads split-adjusted CN forward prices. That is an ordinary total-return cohort measurement, not nominal CNY tick evidence; market, benchmark, upstream selection and horizon all differ from the US cells, so the columns are context rather than interchangeable estimates

cohort_split.note: board lanes are DIFFERENT POPULATIONS and are never pooled: every statistic below is computed inside one lane. A row with no lane is reported under 'unlaned', never folded into 'buy'

coverage.note: an episode with no entry status is EXCLUDED from the table rather than bucketed; the count above is what that exclusion costs

price_basis_era.note: two price eras live in this parquet, split at 2026-08-06. 'unverified_pre_20260806' rows priced the name leg from the raw breadth caches against a back-adjusted benchmark, so a dividend could book as underperformance in excess_spy; rows are never re-graded across the boundary. Era 1 is UNVERIFIED, not presumed wrong — disclosed here as counts so a reader can weight a cell, never filtered out, because dropping rows would be this module re-grading

definitions.as_of_range: as_of_first/as_of_last on a status cell span the MARKED rows — the ones that produced n_excess — never the cell's episodes. A long horizon selects a VINTAGE: a 63-session mark needs 63 sessions to exist, so at long horizons the marked subset is systematically the EARLIEST board dates. Two statuses compared at one horizon can therefore be two different eras, and these dates are what make that visible before the rates are ranked
definitions.cohort: lane — the board lane the episode was admitted into. Lanes are different selections and are never pooled
definitions.entry_status: entry_status — entry_signal.status as snapshotted on the board-admission day, NOT re-derived tonight
definitions.excess_unit: fraction of price — 0.01 = +1.00%, in the ledger's own unit
definitions.interval: loser_rate_wilson_lo/hi and win_rate_wilson_lo/hi are the 95% Wilson score interval on the rate beside them, over that cell's n_excess. Same ruler as the sibling board table (scripts/grade_us_board.wilson_ci), replicated rather than imported so an engine module does not depend on a scripts one. Wilson, not the normal approximation, because thin cells are printed here by design: a Wald interval runs outside [0,1] at small n and collapses to zero width at 0% or 100%
definitions.loser_and_win: loser = excess_spy <= 0 (a FLAT mark counts as a loss); win = excess_spy > 0. The two are exact complements by construction — two views of one binary outcome, not two independent observations. The <=0 boundary matches the historical CN adjusted-return context so the labels are comparable; authority is not
definitions.thin: a cell with fewer than 20 graded marks is labelled thin and read as directional only; it is still printed

block.graded_by: scripts.grade_us_board — engine.grading.forward_metrics (next-bar fill, positional session horizons), excess vs SPY. Nothing is regraded here: the marks are read exactly as that grader wrote them
block.no_pooled_figure: there is deliberately no top-level loser rate, win rate or median excess. A figure pooled across lanes would describe the lane mix, not the statuses. The only top-level numbers here are counts and dates
block.purpose: ANTICIPATION §6.6 — the STANDING evidence loop for the patience-first entry ladder. The separately reviewed A2 map (#4976) is intended to ship STATUS-NEUTRAL (one flat value across the five admissible statuses) after the first US run did not reproduce the historical CN adjusted-return ordering. That comparator is context only; the US read is short-horizon, legacy-selection, price-basis-mixed and vintage-confounded, and the patience horizon is empty. The record therefore licenses no differential ordering. This table keeps accruing behind the neutral no-claim default
block.reintroduction_bar: an ordering may be put back into the map ONLY when all four hold together: at the ladder's chartered horizon; n>=50 per cell (the thin floor LABELS a cell, it does not qualify one); sign-stable across two half-splits of the window; on era-stamped anticipation-v1 episodes. Until then the leg stays neutral. This block re-introduces nothing — any map edit is a separate reviewed change
block.w7_priority_store: the §6.6 charter named data/us_prophet_rank as the source. MEASURED 2026-08-08: its grades/ subtree has never been written (zero forward marks) and its candidates/ store carries no entry-status column — only the already-mapped, non-injective prophet_entry leg, on the buy lane only. Reading a mapped value to re-derive the map is circular, so this block reads the board ledger. It is also the closer population-shape match to the historical CN context because both are Prophet standout-board admissions — not because either is an exact legal-limit board. When a sibling lane stamps entry_signal.status into the W7 candidates store it becomes a second, wider US read — not a replacement
